data.narrative:
Figure AI, a Series C artificial intelligence and software company founded by Brett Adcock, has raised over $1.0B to date and carries a reported valuation of $39B. The valuation analysis employs a peer-median approach triangulated against a universe of 9 comparables in the AI & Software sector: 1 public company (Palantir, ticker PLTR) and 8 private firms at same or adjacent funding stages.

The Stage-Progression method was excluded due to internal inconsistency: applying a standard 1.7x Series C step-up multiplier to the $39B reported base value yields $66.3B, which exceeds 20x the company's total capital raised—a sanity threshold violation suggesting the funding-tracker valuation is unreliable. The Peer-Median method, by contrast, is applicable and yields $9.3B based on a cohort of 6 matched peers: Scale AI ($29.0B, Series B), Skild AI ($14.0B, Series C), Crusoe Energy ($10.0B, Series C), Wayve ($8.6B, Series D), and Physical Intelligence ($5.6B, Series B). The peer range spans $3.2B to $29.0B.

The triangulated valuation range is $7.9B (low) to $10.7B (high), with a median of $9.3B. This single-method result introduces material uncertainty, particularly around how Figure AI's capital efficiency and product maturity compare to Skild AI and Crusoe Energy within the Series C cohort. The wide peer dispersion ($3.2B–$29.0B) underscores heterogeneity in the current AI funding environment.
